name: lot_developer_session_seed
description: Foundations 6.3 [choice]: the lot developer's file-local generator (0x00B49AF0) is seeded with derive(K) = S XOR K, moved by XOR 1 when it would be 0 or 0xFFFFFFFF; K is the original's clock XOR constant 0x6C09C0F4 (the seed of the file-local cRZRandom at program start, §10.1). Expected states from an independent model of derive(): 0x12345678 -> 0x7E3D968C (an arbitrary session); 0x00000000 -> 0x6C09C0F4 (session 0 = the original's seed at clock value 0); 0x6C09C0F4 -> 0x00000001 (S = K: S XOR K = 0 is moved to 1); 0x93F63F0B -> 0xFFFFFFFE (S = NOT K: 0xFFFFFFFF is moved to 0xFFFFFFFE). Both cRZRandom states start at the seed (§6.1) and rand() stays at its process-start state 1 (the game never seeds it, foundations §12).
